initialize.instructions:
AgentAvow grades the safety of anything an AI agent connects to — a GitHub repo, an MCP server, an npm/PyPI/crates/Docker/Hugging Face package, or a wallet-linked identity — and returns one of three answers with its reason (Safe to connect, Review before you connect, or Do not connect), a signed 0-100 trust score that anyone can recompute offline, and an adoption score.

When to use which tool:
• scan_repo — a GitHub repo, passed as 'owner/name'.
• scan_package — a published package (registry + name).
• scan_mcp_server — a live MCP server, by its https URL (checks the tool definitions themselves for poisoning/injection).
• verify_trust / check_interaction_safety / lookup_identity / get_trust_badge — agent-to-agent identity and trust.

Reading a verdict: each result leads with one of three answers and its reason: 'Safe to connect', 'Review before you connect', or 'Do not connect', with ' · Certified' where the tool earned it. A 0-100 trust score and an adoption score sit underneath. Every result links to a full report and a signed (Ed25519/JWS) attestation. All tools are read-only and need no account.

A good habit is to scan a tool before connecting or installing it. To do that automatically for every new tool, a user can add a one-line CLAUDE.md rule or a SessionStart hook (setup: https://agentavow.com/docs/auto-scan-claude-code) — this is the user's own opt-in config.

tools.description: Scan a public GitHub repository with AgentAvow and return whether it is safe for an agent to connect to: one of three answers with its reason (Safe to connect, Review before you connect, or Do not connect), a 0-100 trust score, an adoption score from real usage (stars), the findings behind it (with where and how to fix), and a signed, offline-verifiable attestation. Read-only, no account. Calls the AgentAvow public API at agentavow.com.

force.description: Re-scan now instead of returning the cached verdict (results cache ~1h). Use after the target has changed.

repo.description: Repo as 'owner/name' (e.g. 'vercel/next.js'), or just the name when 'owner' is given separately.

tools.name: scan_repo

adoption.description: The adoption score: real usage (downloads per week, stars or installs). Never changes the decision.

advisories_affecting_version.description: Published advisories that affect this version.

certified_mark.description: Certified and safe: show the Certified mark.

decision.description: The answer to lead with: safe = Safe to connect, review = Review before you connect, do_not_connect = Do not connect.

decision_final.description: False while the behavioral sandbox is still running; the decision can still change.

decision_reason.description: One sentence naming what decided it.

deprecated.description: The maintainer's deprecation notice, or null.

incident.description: Known past compromise (context only, never scored).

install.description: Install command, only when nothing blocks it.

rescan_pending.description: A fresh scan was started; this is the previous result.

sandbox.description: What the behavioral sandbox observed; null if it does not apply.

signed.description: True when a signed (Ed25519/JWS) attestation backs this.

subscores.description: Per-category 0-100 scores behind the trust score.

target_type.description: github, npm, pypi, crates, docker, hf, or mcp.

tier.description: Trust tier for the score (detail, not the headline).

top_findings.description: Up to five most important findings.

trust_score.description: Trust score, 0-100. Evidence under the decision.

verdict.description: Binary form of the decision, kept for older clients.

verdict_reason.description: Machine reason for the binary verdict, e.g. clean, blocking_findings, thin_coverage.

tools.description: Scan a published package (npm, PyPI, crates, Docker, or Hugging Face) with AgentAvow. Returns one of three answers with its reason (Safe to connect, Review before you connect, or Do not connect), a 0-100 trust score, an adoption score from real usage (downloads per week), findings with remediation, and a signed attestation. Also reports repo-vs-artifact drift (files shipped that aren't in the source). Read-only; calls agentavow.com.

tools.description: Verify an AgentAvow entity's trust score. Returns trust_score (0-1), trust_score_pct (0-100), trust_tier, and whether it meets a minimum threshold. Read-only, no auth. Use before interacting with an unknown agent.

entity_id.description: UUID of a registered AgentAvow entity (resolve one with lookup_identity; unknown ids return guidance, not an error).

tools.description: Check whether it is safe to interact with another agent by trust threshold. Thresholds: delegate 0.6, trade 0.5, collaborate 0.4, follow 0.1. Returns is_safe, risk_level, the score, and a recommendation. Read-only, no auth.

target_entity_id.description: UUID of a registered target entity (resolve one with lookup_identity).
